Badminton
Modern Badminton was probably developed in the 17th century and
named from the Place 'Badminton' in Gloucestershire (England):
1934. The International Badminton  Federation  (IBF) was established in
Badminton Association of India was formed in 1934_
The trophy for the international matches was named Thomas Cup after
the name of the first president of the IBF Sir George Thomas Thomas
Cupcompetition (for men) started in 1948-49.Uber Cup Championship
(for women) started in 1956

Lawn Tennis
Tennis was introduced by Major Wingfeild in Wales in 1870.
AlL England Championship (popularly known as Wimbledon
Championship) started in 1877 for men only: Tennis competitions for
women (in Wimbledon Championship) were introduced in 1884.
